content.text: I'll start by gathering the current state of all three routers in parallel. Let me write a diagnostic script first.

input.command:
cat << 'PYEOF' > /tmp/diag.py
from netmiko import ConnectHandler

routers = {
    "HQ":      {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.6", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
    "Branch1": {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.5", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
    "Branch2": {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.7", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
}

commands = [
    "show interfaces",
    "show ip ospf neighbor",
    "show ip route",
    "show configuration commands | grep ospf",
    "show configuration commands | grep protocols static",
    "show configuration commands | grep 'interfaces ethernet'",
    "show configuration commands | grep 'interfaces loopback'",
]

for name, params in routers.items():
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  {name} ({params['host']})")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    conn = ConnectHandler(**params)
    for cmd in commands:
        print(f"\n--- {cmd} ---")
        print(conn.send_command(cmd))
    conn.disconnect()
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/diag.py

from netmiko import ConnectHandler

routers = {
    "HQ":      {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.6", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
    "Branch2": {"device_type": "vyos", "host": "192.168.122.7", "username": "vyos", "password": "test"},
}

# Fix HQ

print("  Fixing HQ")
print("=" * 60)

cmds = [
    # Fix eth0 IP
    "delete interfaces ethernet eth0 address 10.10.10.1/22",
    "set interfaces ethernet eth0 address 10.10.0.1/22",
    # Fix OSPF network statement
    "delete protocols ospf area 0 network 10.10.0.0/21",
    "set protocols ospf area 0 network 10.10.0.0/22",
    # Add loopback network to OSPF
    "set protocols ospf area 0 network 209.165.202.128/30",
    # Add static default route via loopback
    "set protocols static route 0.0.0.0/0 interface lo",
    # Redistribute default route into OSPF
    "set protocols ospf default-information originate always",
    "commit",
    "save",
]
output = conn.send_config_set(cmds, exit_config_mode=False)
print(output)
conn.disconnect()

# Fix Branch2
print("=" * 60)
print("  Fixing Branch2")
print("=" * 60)
conn = ConnectHandler(**routers["Branch2"])
cmds = [
    # Enable eth2
    "delete interfaces ethernet eth2 disable",
    # Fix OSPF network for eth0
    "delete protocols ospf area 0 network 10.10.4.0/22",
    "set protocols ospf area 0 network 10.10.6.0/23",
    # Fix passive: remove from eth2, add to eth0
    "delete protocols ospf interface eth2 passive",
    "set protocols ospf interface eth0 passive",
    "commit",
    "save",
]
output = conn.send_config_set(cmds, exit_config_mode=False)
print(output)
conn.disconnect()

print("\nDone fixing. Waiting for OSPF convergence...")
